lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's sixteen? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 16? Nope!

lines.text: Twenty-four kids. Twenty like pizza, eighteen like pasta, and sixteen like soup.
lines.caption: 24 kids. 20 like pizza, 18 like pasta, and 16 like soup.

lines.text: What's the smallest possible number who like all three?
lines.caption: What's the smallest possible number who like all three?

lines.text: Count the kids who say no!
lines.caption: Count the kids who say no!

lines.text: Four kids say no to pizza, six say no to pasta, and eight say no to soup.
lines.caption: 4 kids say no to pizza, 6 say no to pasta, and 8 say no to soup.

lines.text: Give them to different kids, so no kid says no twice. That's eighteen kids.
lines.caption: Give them to different kids, so no kid says no twice. That's 18 kids.

lines.text: Everyone else says yes to all three!
lines.caption: Everyone else says yes to all three!

lines.text: Twenty-four minus eighteen. That's six kids!
lines.caption: 24 minus 18. That's 6 kids!

lines.text: Sixteen was the trap. That's the most, not the fewest.
lines.caption: 16 was the trap. That's the most, not the fewest.

lines.text: Did you get six? Tell me below!
